description: Land Acquisition - Mamudawala, Yatinuwara D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette notice pertains specifically to land acquisition matters under The Land Acquisition Act. It announces a correction to the date of inquiries for a specific land parcel (Lot No. 1 in Preliminary Plan No. Maha 1888) in Mamudawala village, Yatinuwara Division, Kandy District. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it deals with land acquisition procedures and notifications.
